By default, if no policies exist in a namespace, then all ingress and egress traffic is allowed to

### Default deny all ingress traffic

(code sample: service/networking/network-policy-default-deny-ingress.yaml)

that explicitly allows that.

(code sample: service/networking/network-policy-allow-all-ingress.yaml)
